description.zh: Victor42 自研的 AI Agent 能力包。每个 skill 是一组结构化指令，安装后你的 Agent 在特定场景下会自动调用。用 skills CLI 一键安装，或打开详情页复制命令。
description.en: Capability packs for AI agents by Victor42. Each skill is a structured instruction set your agent loads for specific tasks. Install with the skills CLI, or copy the command from a detail page.

summary.zh: 当你做到一半要换 AI 工具，它把进度、决策与下一步交接给下一棒。
summary.en: When a task is half done and you switch AI tools, it hands the progress, decisions and next steps to the next agent.

zh.heading: 它做什么
items: 换到另一个 AI 工具时，生成一份临时交接包（通常只有一份 notes.md）
只回答一个问题：下一棒要继续推进，还缺什么
典型场景：任务做到一半要换工具——目标、改过哪些文件、验证过的命令、下一步与红线，一次交代清楚，不必从头复述
脚本、结构化数据、长日志才单独成文件

zh.heading: 交接包里有什么
items: Goal / Context / Current State（已完成 · 已验证 · 待办）/ Handoff Notes
只保留继续推进所必需的路径、决策与约束
接手方做完全部待办后删掉整个包；够不到位置时由你删

zh.heading: 两种交接通道
items: 本地目录：开箱即用，写成本机 handoff-<主题>/，不依赖网络与凭据
对象存储：一次性配好桶、token 与 config 之后，跨机器、跨工具都能取
云端没配置就不问、直接本地；配置了但不通才问你选本地还是修云端，不静默降级

zh.heading: 何时触发
items: 你明确说「交接」「handoff」「换 Agent」「我要换工具继续」
多轮任务中途要换工具，又不想丢上下文
你接手别人的交接包：按包内待办推进，做完负责删包

en.heading: What it does
items: Builds a temporary handoff package (usually a single notes.md) when you switch AI tools
Answers one question: what does the next agent need to keep going
Typical case: a task half done in one tool, picked up in another — goal, files changed, commands verified, next steps and red lines stated once instead of re-explained
Scripts, structured data or long logs get separate files

en.heading: What's in the package
items: Goal / Context / Current State (done · verified · open) / Handoff Notes
Only the paths, decisions and constraints needed to continue
The receiving agent deletes the whole package once every open item is done; you delete it if it can't reach the location

en.heading: Two channels
items: Local directory: works out of the box, writes handoff-<theme>/ on this machine, no network or credentials
Object storage: after a one-time bucket, token and config setup, packages cross machines and tools
Unconfigured cloud never asks and goes local; only a configured-but-unreachable cloud asks local-or-fix — no silent downgrade

en.heading: When it triggers
items: You explicitly ask for a handoff / agent switch / tool transfer
A multi-turn task needs to survive switching AI tools
You receive someone's handoff package: work its open items, then delete it

summary.zh: 当你有一堆图片、视频或文件夹要批量处理，说一句话，它替你跑完命令。
summary.en: When a pile of images, videos or nested folders needs batch work, say it in one line and it runs the commands for you.

zh.heading: 你说一句，它干活
items: 「把这些 png 转成 webp」→ 整个文件夹批量转，同名文件自动加序号
「把这张图缩到 800px」→ 等比缩放，不裁掉内容
「这几张图合成 GIF」→ 多帧合成，也能把 GIF 拆回帧序列
「从视频里提取音频」→ mp4 直接出 mp3
「把嵌套文件夹里的文件都提取出来」→ 压平到一层，文件名不丢
不用自己写命令：装好后用自然语言说，Agent 去调脚本

zh.heading: 图片
items: 格式互转：jpg / jpeg / png / webp / avif / gif / bmp / tiff 任意互转
按尺寸改：指定宽高，裁剪或填充
按边长缩放：设定最大边长，保持比例
裁头像：自动检测人脸，输出圆形或方形
去重：感知哈希找相似图，副本移入单独目录，保留最清晰那张
GIF：多帧合成，或拆成帧序列

zh.heading: 音视频
items: 音频互转：mp3 / wav / flac / aac / ogg / m4a / opus
视频互转：mp4 / avi / mov / mkv / webm 等，可转 GIF
提取音轨：从视频里取出音频
图片合成视频：多张图拼接，支持交叉淡入淡出

zh.heading: 下载
items: 公众号文章内嵌视频：按视频标题命名，可选最高清或全部清晰度

zh.heading: 文件管理
items: 嵌套文件夹压平到一层
按 CSV 批量重命名
单文件与整文件夹都支持

zh.heading: 动手前会发生什么
items: 首次运行自动检查 Python 3.8+ 与依赖包，缺了帮你装
只有音视频的活才需要 FFmpeg（4.3+），纯图片处理不需要
批量转换、压平、重命名可以先看一份计划（dry-run）再执行
同名文件自动加序号，不覆盖原文件

en.heading: Say it, it runs it
items: “Turn these pngs into webp” → whole-folder batch, same-name files get numbered
“Scale this image to 800px” → proportional, nothing cropped
“Turn these images into a GIF” → multi-frame compose, or split a GIF back into frames
“Pull the audio out of this video” → mp4 in, mp3 out
“Flatten this nested folder” → one level, no filenames lost
No commands to write: install it, speak plainly, the agent calls the scripts

en.heading: Images
items: Convert between jpg / jpeg / png / webp / avif / gif / bmp / tiff
Resize by exact width and height, crop or pad
Scale by longest edge, keeping the aspect ratio
Avatar crop: face detection, round or square output
Dedupe: perceptual hash finds near-duplicates, moves copies to a separate folder and keeps the sharpest one
GIF: compose frames into a GIF, or split one back into frames

en.heading: Audio and video
items: Convert mp3 / wav / flac / aac / ogg / m4a / opus
Convert mp4 / avi / mov / mkv / webm and more; video to GIF
Extract the audio track from a video
Build a video from stills, with cross-fades

en.heading: Downloads
items: Videos embedded in WeChat articles: named after the video title, highest quality only or every quality

en.heading: File management
items: Flatten a nested folder into one level
Batch rename from a CSV
Single files or whole folders

en.heading: What happens before it touches your files
items: First run checks Python 3.8+ and the dependency packages, installing what's missing
FFmpeg (4.3+) is only needed for audio and video work; image-only tasks don't need it
Batch convert, flatten and rename can run a dry-run plan first
Same-name files get numbered; originals are never overwritten

summary.zh: 当你要查航班、火车、天气或地点，它让 AI 给真数据而不是编一个；只给数据，不排行程。
summary.en: When you need flights, trains, weather or places, it makes the agent answer from real data instead of guessing — data only, no itinerary.

zh.heading: 能帮你问什么
items: 「明天杭州飞成都还有票吗，最早一班几点」→ 班次、时刻、票价区间
「周六上海到南京的高铁，下午两点后还有座吗」→ 车次、历时、余票、票价
「下周三丽江会下雨吗」「去年十月大理什么天气」→ 未来预报、历史同期
「西湖到灵隐寺多远，开车要多久」→ 坐标、周边地点、驾车/步行/公交路线

zh.heading: 数据从哪来
items: 高德：地址与坐标、周边地点、路线、天气、地图
飞常准：航班计划、中转方案、票价
携程：车次、历时、余票、票价
Open-Meteo：天气预报、历史天气
高德与飞常准需要自备 Key（高德控制台申请，飞常准的申请指引随包附带）；携程与 Open-Meteo 开箱即用

zh.heading: 它不做什么
items: 不排行程：给数据与规划顺序，不给景点筛选与小时级日程
不抓大众点评 / 小红书：无公开 API，风控严格
不给结论：数据可以给全，取舍由人定

zh.heading: 为什么答案靠得住
items: 四类数据都附实测校验：景点坐标必须按地名检索，航班与中转要用不同的三字码，航班列表要自行按时刻排序，报错提示可能指向一个服务端根本不读的请求头
这些规则写在 skill 本体里，Agent 每次调用都照此执行

en.heading: What you can ask
items: “Any seats on tomorrow's Hangzhou–Chengdu flight, and when is the first one?” → schedules, times, fare ranges
“Shanghai–Nanjing high-speed trains on Saturday after 2pm — any seats?” → services, duration, availability, fares
“Will it rain in Lijiang next Wednesday?” “What was Dali like last October?” → forecast, same period in past years
“How far is Lingyin Temple from West Lake, and how long by car?” → coordinates, nearby places, driving/walking/transit routes

en.heading: Where the data comes from
items: Amap: addresses and coordinates, nearby places, routes, weather, map tiles
Variflight: flight schedules, transfers, fares
Ctrip: services, duration, availability, fares
Open-Meteo: forecast, historical weather
Amap and Variflight need your own key (Amap console; a Variflight application guide ships with the skill); Ctrip and Open-Meteo work as-is

en.heading: What it doesn't do
items: No itinerary: data and planning order only — no attraction shortlisting, no hour-level schedule
No scraping Dianping / Xiaohongshu: no public API, strict anti-bot
No verdicts: data can be complete, the trade-offs stay with you

en.heading: Why the answers hold up
items: All four sources ship verified rules: attraction coordinates need a place-name search, flights and transfers use different three-letter codes, flight lists must be sorted by time, and error text can point at a header the server never reads
Those rules live in the skill itself, so the agent follows them on every call

summary.zh: 当你想真正读懂一首古诗，它按六个维度写一篇有出处的完整解读。
summary.en: When you want to actually understand a classical Chinese poem, it writes one full reading along six lenses, with sources.

zh.heading: 读出来是什么样
items: 交付物是一份完整文档：原文 → 六维解读 → 六合收敛 → 收敛时间线（表格 + 交汇反应 + 系年注）
例：杜牧《过华清宫》的【世】——「写盛唐是为了诊断晚唐：距安史之乱七十年，宦官掌神策军、藩镇形同独立。诗的政治锋芒就在这古今同构里。」
不是一行翻译，也不是把现成赏析换个说法

zh.heading: 六个维度各做什么
items: 【世】时代：这首诗何以在此刻写成
【人】作者：什么处境与身份让它成为必然
【地】地理：地名与空间如何落地成意象
【统】传统：它继承或改写了什么
【受】接受史：后人怎么读它，为什么传下来
【文】本体：技艺与结构——它为何是艺术

zh.heading: 它靠什么保证不出错
items: 色温先对齐学界主流读法：自己的解读与有据主流相悖时，改的是解读，不是硬拗
生卒、系年、字号、官职这类主张要定位到一手史料；查不到就写成假说，有多说就列多说
平仄、韵部、体裁按平水韵核查，不靠猜

zh.heading: 什么时候不用
items: 现代自由诗、只是想要一句翻译、作者不可考或资料极稀的篇目
想要一段短评或金句，而不是一篇完整解读

en.heading: What a reading looks like
items: One complete document: the poem → six-lens reading → convergence → a convergence timeline (table, cross-currents, dating notes)

For Du Mu's *Passing Huaqing Palace*, the era lens reads the High Tang scene as a diagnosis of the late Tang — seventy years after An Lushan, eunuchs holding the palace army, warlords running their own provinces; the political edge sits in that mirroring
Not a line-by-line translation, and not an existing essay reworded

en.heading: What each lens does
items: Era — why this poem could only be written at this moment
Author — which circumstances and identity made it inevitable
Geography — how place names and space become imagery
Tradition — what it inherits or rewrites
Reception — how later readers took it, and why it survived
Craft — technique and structure: why it is art

en.heading: Why it holds up
items: Emotional temperature is checked against the scholarly mainstream first; if the reading conflicts with a documented consensus, the reading changes, not the consensus
Dates, ages, courtesy names and offices must be traced to a primary source; without one the claim is written as a hypothesis, and competing accounts are listed
Tonal patterns, rhyme categories and form are checked against the Pingshui rhyme tables, not guessed

en.heading: When not to use it
items: Modern free verse, a plain translation, or a poem whose author and dating are unknown or thinly documented
You want a short verdict or a quotable line, not a full reading

summary.zh: 当你想不透一件事，它短问短答，同时把你的理解长成一份框架。
summary.en: When a question won't come clear, it asks one short question at a time while your understanding grows into one structured document.

zh.heading: 对话长什么样
items: 你说：「冰箱里的菜总在坏，扔的时候还挺内疚」
侧边框架原位长出四层——
已确认现象：菜是周末一次买齐的，坏掉的多是叶菜
机制假设：采购按周、消耗按天，单位错配最先崩在最不耐放的菜上
跨层边：下班时间 → 一周做几次饭 → 一次买多少
待验证：那几天没做饭，是没时间，还是没心情
它只回一两句：「坏的多是叶菜，说明问题在采购节奏，不在记性。这周有几天是明确没时间做饭的？」
侧边那份文档你看得见：原生侧边栏、你指定的本地 Markdown，或云端一个未公开列出的 Gist

zh.heading: 什么时候值得开
items: 一件事反复想不透，需要被一层层问下去
要跟 AI 多轮共建一个理解，而不是问一句拿一个答案
想把过程中的假设、反例、已确认细节留下来
只有你明确要求时才启动，普通提问不会变成大工程

zh.heading: 它跟普通聊天差在哪
items: 聊天保持短促：每轮最多推进一个因果问题，不甩一大段综述
侧边文档原位展开：不写流水账，已确认的细节与未定的猜测分开放，不丢
从具体现象切入，向下追到第一性原理，并标出跨层的因果

zh.heading: 边界与隐私
items: 不用于一次性解释、翻译或内容发布
云端走 secret Gist：未公开列出，但并不等于加密；涉及敏感内容它会先问你
本地模式只写你指定的那个文件，不自己挑路径

en.heading: What a session looks like
items: You say: “Vegetables keep going bad in my fridge, and binning them feels awful.”
The side surface expands that node in place —
Confirmed: groceries are bought once a week, and the waste is mostly leafy greens
Mechanism hypothesis: shopping runs weekly, eating runs daily — the mismatch breaks first on whatever perishes fastest
Cross-layer edge: commute hours → how often you cook → how much you buy at once
Open question: on the days you didn't cook, was it no time or no appetite for it
It replies in one or two sentences: “It's mostly leafy greens, so this is buying rhythm, not memory. How many days this week did you genuinely have no time to cook?”
You can watch that document: a native side panel, a local Markdown file you name, or one unlisted Gist in the cloud

en.heading: When it earns its place
items: A question keeps resisting you and needs to be asked down, layer by layer
You want to co-build an understanding over many turns, not collect one-shot answers
You want the hypotheses, counterexamples and confirmed details to survive the conversation
It only starts when you ask for it; an ordinary question won't turn into this

en.heading: How it differs from ordinary chat
items: Chat stays short: at most one causal question per turn, no wall of summary
The side document is rewritten in place: never a changelog, and confirmed detail or open uncertainty is never dropped
It enters through a concrete phenomenon, digs down to first principles, and marks causal edges that cross layers

en.heading: Boundaries and privacy
items: Not for one-off explanations, translation or publishing
The cloud path uses a secret Gist: unlisted, which is not the same as encrypted — it asks first before publishing anything sensitive
Local mode writes only the file you name, and never picks a path itself
